title: PM <> Eng Lead 1:1 prep - API/Console/Dedicated/Private
content:
Goal for this 1:1:
- Sync on short-term priorities across API, Console, Dedicated & Private delivery tracks
- Surface blockers on release + customer escalations
- Agree owners and deadlines for follow-ups

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick sync (5 min) - bandwidth, blocking context
2) Release status highlights (8 min):
   - Hosted API: streaming v2 rollout: perf good but customer report of truncated messages after ~512 tokens
   - Console: per-route dashboards + RBAC role views beta to 5 customers this week
   - Dedicated: autoscale policy change; SLA risk if node reclaim delays >30s
   - Private: ACME onboarding: KMS + audit log reqs
3) Blockers / risks (8 min):
   - Truncated streaming: suspect tokenization/event ordering issue; reproduce with ACME testset (Samir)
   - Autoscaler flapping in us-west-2 on p4 pools: need SRE trace + increase log retention (Maya)
   - Console RBAC bug: non-admins seeing rollout controls in beta; plan rollback if not fixed by Thu
4) Prioritization (4 min): proposed order -> streaming fix > RBAC fix > autoscaler tweak
5) Action items + owners (5 min)

Context notes:
- Streaming truncation: logs show client receives end-of-stream earlier than runtime; repro steps in JIRA-PROD-1423. Might be client chunking + prefix cache interaction.
- Console: scoreboard endpoint (avg token cost on hover) blocked on backend PR-842.
- Dedicated autoscaler: kernel upgrade increased pod startup by ~10s; 3 flaps in 48h.
- ACME: require HSM keywrap + 90-day audit retention; compliance review Tue.

Decisions requested from Samir:
- Triage window today for streaming repro (pair with PM)
- Approve temporary feature gate for streaming v2 for 3 impacted customers if fix >48h
- Approve 24h SRE priority to investigate autoscaler flaps and rollback kernel if needed

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Samir: pair with Oliver to reproduce streaming truncation using ACME corpus; update JIRA-PROD-1423 with root cause by 2026-03-02
- Maya Dawson: run SRE trace for autoscaler flaps, capture node startup latencies, mitigation proposal by 2026-03-03
- Priya Shah (Console lead): merge backend PR-842 and ship scoreboard endpoint behind feature flag; target 2026-03-05
- Oliver Bennett: draft customer note for 3 impacted streaming customers with workaround (reduced chunk-size); send by EOD 2026-03-01
- Solutions Eng / Ops: confirm HSM integration checklist for ACME and share with legal/compliance by 2026-03-04

Follow-ups for next 1:1 (2026-03-08):
- Streaming fix status + customer verification
- Autoscaler mitigation outcome and kernel rollback decision
- Console dashboard beta feedback from first 5 customers
- ACME compliance sign-off status

Scratchpad / TODOs to self:
- Bring tokenization edge-cases doc to repro session
- Ask infra to increase log retention for autoscaler namespace to 72h
- Draft rollback playbook for console RBAC (two-step rollback + customer notification template)

Quick links/snippets:
- JIRA: PROJ-1423 (streaming truncation)
- Confluence: Team QA playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/QA+playbook
- GH PR (console scoreboard): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/842

Tone: keep this meeting tight; use async for deep debugging.
